    "An Open Sky feels like a natural next choice because its explicitly soothing guitar and cello match the calm listening mood of my recent relaxing classical selection.",

    "My country listening seems to have been treated as a broad preference without enough attention to gentle melodies and the mood I want today.",
    "My interest in a particular television soundtrack seems to have been extended to other soundtracks without a clear connection in musical style."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent choice of relaxing classical music makes an explicitly soothing sound especially appealing right now.",
    "The connection across my vocal selections is the expressive singing and polished arrangements; gentle harmonies appeal too, but duets and relaxation music would be my first choices today."
